title: DatasetRef
description: Logical reference to a published downstream-consumable dataset surface. References name the stable surface, not an internal Delta table path.

surface_name.description: Stable logical published surface name, for example published_documents.

surface_version.description: Major version of the published surface contract.

record_key.description: Exact immutable selector for a single published record.

record_filter.description: Filter selector for multiple published records, for example all sections for one processing manifest.
